before: For the finitely generated group M=A(Q), its 2-adic completion tensor Q2 equals M tensor Q2. Choose compatible division points for a finite basis. Their Kummer cocycles give a Z2-linear map from the completion into continuous T2A-valued cocycles. If such a cocycle becomes a coboundary in V2A, multiply its witness by a fixed power2^s to put it in T2A. At every finite level the resulting Kummer class is zero, so finite Kummer injectivity gives2^s times the completed point zero in M/2^nM for every n. It is therefore zero in the completion, and the original point is zero after tensoring Q2. This proves the claimed injection without any finiteness assumption on Sha.
after: Split the finitely generated group M=A(Q) as a free summand F plus its finite torsion subgroup. The natural identification F tensor Q2 = M tensor Q2 removes the torsion. Choose compatible division points for an integral basis of F. Their Kummer cocycles extend Z2-linearly to the free completion F tensor Z2, giving continuous T2A-valued cocycles. If a cocycle from this free completion becomes a coboundary in V2A, multiply its witness by a fixed power 2^s to put it in T2A. At every finite level the resulting Kummer class is zero, so finite Kummer injectivity gives that 2^s times the completed free point has zero image in M/2^nM for every n. Since F is a direct summand, its image is zero in F/2^nF for every n, hence it is zero in F tensor Z2. After tensoring Q2 this proves the claimed injection. This construction does not assert a Z2-linear lift of the torsion completion into T2A-valued cocycles and makes no finiteness assumption on Sha.
